title: Purple
subtitle: An automated pipeline for integrating structured metadata

sections.mission: Automate the harvesting, validation, ingestion and integration of structured data from heterogeneous sources.
sections.challenge: Metadata arrives in different schemas and levels of completeness, making reliable integration difficult to repeat.
approach: Describe source and output contracts with TypeSpec schemas.
Generate artifacts and run scripted transformations that preserve structured metadata.
impact: Make metadata integration workflows repeatable and inspectable.
Reduce manual reshaping when combining structured information from multiple sources.

research.focus: Schema-driven automation for structured metadata integration
